markets.early_close_condition: This market will close after a winner is declared.
markets.rules_primary: If Jeremiyah Love records the most Rushing Yards among all players in the game for the Detroit vs Arizona Pro Football game originally scheduled for Oct 11, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
If Jeremiyah Love does not participate in the game the market will resolve to No. If multiple players tie for the most yards, the markets will resolve to 1/N, where N is the number of players tied for the highest value. No holders will receive $1 minus the Yes payout.

If the game is postponed but begins within 48 hours from its originally scheduled start time, the market will remain open and resolve based on the official final result. If the game is not started within 48 hours, the market will resolve to a fair price.
